label: Sugarscape II-2
description: As II-1, but sugar grows back one unit per period, so agents gather on the peaks and the population falls to the carrying capacity of the landscape.

agents.sugarCell.acts.growBack.description: Sugar grows back one unit a period, up to capacity (legacy SUGAR_GROW_BACK_1_RULE, 'Sugar-Grow Back 1'). II-1 grows it back to capacity at once; this is the one rule that differs between the two.

agents.sugarCell.acts.notMore.description: That sugar, but not more than the capacity.
